description: This file defines a class `NoteViewGridHolderOnlyTitle`, a ViewHolder for displaying notes with only the title in a grid layout within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles UI binding, font styling, and interaction logic specific to notes with only titles.

classes.name: NoteViewGridHolderOnlyTitle
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying note titles in a grid view, supporting font styling and click interactions within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: NoteViewGridHolderOnlyTitle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ViewHolder with binding, click listener, font style, and size.

methods.name: showSwipe
methods.description: Throws an exception as swipe actions are not supported for this ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds note data to the view, manages status, favorite icon, and search query highlighting.

methods.name: getNoteSwipeable
methods.description: Returns null indicating that swipe actions are not applicable for this view.
